description: READ-SCHEMA with no cursor held on the changed table (the earlier DDL was refused 3262 by b's own cursors) and a pause. Process b creates a saved query QT over U and holds a TableDef and its Fields collection of U and the QueryDef, with no recordset open. Process a ALTER TABLE U ADD COLUMN Z, CREATE INDEX IX_UZ, sets QT's SQL, then DROP TABLE U and CREATE TABLE U again with the extra column and a row (Errors before/after each). b pauses 7 s, Idle, reads the held TableDef (Name, Fields.Count, Indexes.Count), the held QueryDef SQL, then refreshed TableDefs/Fields and a fresh Item(), opens SELECT * FROM U and reads its fields. Asks whether held descriptors show the new schema, only after Refresh, or never, and what an old descriptor does.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
